id: \bSawyer: Well \PN. Looks like it's time. I'll show you everything I've learned.
en: \bSawyer: Well \PN. Looks like it's time. I'll show you everything I've learned.
it: \bSawyer: Bene, \PN. Sembra che sia arrivato il momento. Ti mostrerò tutto quello che ho imparato.

id: \bSawyer: Thank you so much for everything you've taught me \PN. I'll continue to get even better.
en: \bSawyer: Thank you so much for everything you've taught me \PN. I'll continue to get even better.
it: \bSawyer: Grazie mille per tutto quello che mi hai insegnato, \PN. Continuerò a migliorare ancora.

id: \bCongratulations on winning your fifth match. \nYour final battle will be right here.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your fifth match. \nYour final battle will be right here.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il quinto incontro. \nLa tua lotta finale si terrà proprio qui.

id: \bSawyer: Well \PN. Looks like it's time. I'll show you everything I've learned after we last parted ways.
en: \bSawyer: Well \PN. Looks like it's time. I'll show you everything I've learned after we last parted ways.
it: \bSawyer: Bene, \PN. Sembra che sia arrivato il momento. Ti mostrerò tutto quello che ho imparato da quando ci siamo separati.

id: \bSawyer: My analysis really paid off this time!
en: \bSawyer: My analysis really paid off this time!
it: \bSawyer: Stavolta la mia analisi ha dato i suoi frutti!

id: \bSawyer: Thank you so much again for everything you've taught me \PN. I'll surpass you one day while you're still the Monarch, just watch!
en: \bSawyer: Thank you so much again for everything you've taught me \PN. I'll surpass you one day while you're still the Monarch, just watch!
it: \bSawyer: Grazie ancora di tutto quello che mi hai insegnato, \PN. Un giorno ti supererò mentre sei ancora il Monarca, vedrai!
